name: Denise Hayes
source:
Your childhood friend Denise is a girl who likes to hang around boys and act and dress like them in order to blend in. She thinks she is a freak of nature with her tallness and athleticism that rivals boys her age and believes that no boy would feel any attraction towards her.

[In game description]
